description: Burgdorf Castle crowns the hill above the Emme, a Zähringen complex whose square keep of about 1200 carries a hipped roof and battlements beside the palas and the curved gate tower. The old town and its church sit below the rock. This is not Thun Castle on the lake. The Open-Meteo model is nearly fully overcast and mild, with no rain.
